title: Noa-21 wardrobe, hair and expression variation
user_request_verbatim: 전체를 봤는데 한두 이미지가 조금 거슬려보이는거 빼고는 괜찮아. 다음 단계 진행해줘
source_idea: The angle set holds one outfit, one expression and one framing, which is the gap the Lia work identified in its own training set. Variation is shot rather than edited: on the still path a wardrobe change topped out at 0.805 while the same change inside a clip reached 0.930. Wardrobe comes from the record's own scene_defaults.wardrobe_direction and hair from its flexible_variables, not from anything invented here. Three mirrored clips also fill the left profile, which came out at one frame against twenty-five on the right.
